# A33′ — Parity

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](../README.md) · [Other face: A33 — Epistemic Cultivation / Operational Parity](../A33-Epistemic-Cultivation-Operational-Parity.md) · [Shared A/C root](AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

Distinctions promoted into design must yield some inspectable consequence in operation, or they are decoration. [A33 — Epistemic Cultivation / Operational Parity](../A33-Epistemic-Cultivation-Operational-Parity.md) established the discipline: when a philosophical or formal distinction is used to justify a technical feature, the claimed difference must have an identifiable operational locus and a consequence that inspection or a meaningful test can discriminate. A33′ re-sites the discipline reflexively, on this field's own claims: typed authority ([A25′](A25-prime-Covenant-Architecture.md)), the authored session ([A28′](A28-prime-The-Authored-Session.md)), the return circuit ([A29′](A29-prime-Return-or-Extraction.md)), unmerged worlds ([A30′](A30-prime-Shared-Worlds-Unmerged.md)), model-revising alignment ([A31′](A31-prime-Deference-as-Co-Evolutionary-Alignment.md)), the [[section-rooms/arguments/conjugate/A32-prime-The-Mirror-Is-a-Film.md#4|Audited Film]] ([A32′](A32-prime-The-Mirror-Is-a-Film.md)) — each must name where it would change an operation, or acknowledge itself as prose.

The primitive face is registers + S3/P4 — the Gate: the execution checkpoint where a candidate's experience is adjudicated before adoption. Parity is the Gate applied to claims themselves: a distinction passes when its removal would make an observable difference, and fails when it would not.

## #1

The venue's design questions are parity questions in exactly this sense. Q10 asks what interfaces, "against a constrained action-space, instead cultivate the abstraction and tolerance for ambiguity that agent orchestration demands" (PDF p. 57; verified local transcription, uncarded). Q11 asks for design primitives for agent-to-agent interfaces that "presume both cooperation and adversariality as norms" (PDF p. 57; uncarded). Both demand the operationalization, not the mood: an interface that claims to enact tolerance for ambiguity must enact it in the action-space — what becomes selectable, deferrable, revisable — not in the copy's register. And the [harness-centric passage](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q038) fixes the locus: "capability in deployment is not a property of weights alone. It is a property of the harness — the scaffolding of tools, memory, shared knowledge bases, agent protocols, and institutional interfaces through which a model acts on the world." A distinction encoded nowhere in the harness is prose about the model. These are **Paraphrased** venue propositions; the parity reading of them is the essay's own.

## #2

The discipline binds when a distinction justifies a feature. Name the operation carrying it — [C45 — Operational Parity](../concepts/C45-Operational-Parity.md) **defines** the list: retrieval, storage, routing, permission, exclusion retention, evaluator, collaboration, return. Then hold the siblings to it. World versus world-model must show up as which represented state changed and which encountered resistance prompted the change — A33's own test. Source versus derivative judgment: whether a derivative overwrite changes standing. Deference: whether a violated expectation reaches the model that expected ([A31′](A31-prime-Deference-as-Co-Evolutionary-Alignment.md)'s five sites are the discriminators). Return: whether attributable difference changes any office able to act ([A29′](A29-prime-Return-or-Extraction.md)'s ornamental-oversight test). Typed authority: whether a challenge has write-access to the criterion it contests ([A25′](A25-prime-Covenant-Architecture.md)). The audited film: whether the output-to-input edge is inspectable ([A32′](A32-prime-The-Mirror-Is-a-Film.md)). Each sibling already carries its parity clause; A33′ is where they are held together and answerable as one discipline.

## #3

**The negative result counts.** A relation that cannot be implemented, varied and removed with observable difference is prose, however true it sounds. The [[section-rooms/arguments/conjugate/A33-prime-Parity.md#3|Removal Edge]] matters most: delete the disclosure, sever the challenge route, freeze the evaluator, merge the worlds, close the audit — and the operation must measurably change. This protects against decoration in both directions: against philosophy that never touches the machine, and against machine features that borrow philosophy's prestige without its operation. A33's concept–test feedback returns intact: a failed test is one of three findings — the implementation is wrong, the operational mapping is inadequate, or the test cannot discriminate the distinction — and each returns the question to a different home. [C46 — Epistemic Cultivation](../concepts/C46-Epistemic-Cultivation.md) **defines** the continuing practice: preserve the path of change, so a distinction that passed at one scope is re-tested at another rather than banked.

## #4

What parity does not demand. Not every philosophical distinction must become a data object — C45's own boundary, retained: a distinction can remain valid unencoded, and the essay does not owe the machine its every concept. A passing implementation test does not prove the metaphysics that motivated the feature. And the venue's scenarios stay scenarios: Q10 and Q11 are pressures toward buildable answers, not evidence for any architecture, [q042](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q042)'s rider governing the whole register.

Applied to this field's own honesty: the A′ nodes are arguments, not implementations. Their operational consequences are specified — what would count, at which gate, removable with what observable difference — and remain to be run. A33′ passes its own test by naming where each sibling's claim would live in an inspectable operation, and by accepting that a sibling whose consequence cannot be specified is decoration and should be flagged to the author rather than published as force.

## #5→0

A distinction survives as a changed operation, or returns to its concept for revision. S3/P4's Gate closes the arc's circuit — the covenant-into-agentworld claims of Arc IV are offered under this Gate, inspectable or withdrawn — and the same Gate opens onto the field's own production: these drafts pass through author review, the one gate that is already running. The inquiry remains capable of changing its own instruments without promoting the latest instrument into its ground — A33's own closing discipline, held one arc later.

The page **returns-to** [A33 — Epistemic Cultivation / Operational Parity](../A33-Epistemic-Cultivation-Operational-Parity.md) and the conjugate root [A/C](AC.md): the partner gave the enactment test for distinctions justifying features; A33′ turns the test on the conjugate field itself — the arc's claims bind where they can be implemented, varied and removed with observable difference, and count as prose where they cannot.

**Depth Restoration:** the enactment test, the operation-naming list, the concept–test feedback and the minimal/maximal programme boundary are restored from A33's packet and C45/C46. Developed from the ratified Arc IV workshop entry (WORKSHOP-DRAFT-2026-09-07 §2). No experiment is claimed as run; the reflexive application to the A′ field is the re-siting.

**Unresolved Delta:** Q10 and Q11 (p. 57) are used from the verified local transcription and lack q-cards — a source-house collation debt. The concrete acceptance-test patterns C45 names as its own remaining depth remain Open here too. Whether each sibling's specified consequence is the right one is a question the author's review must adjudicate; this node's claim is that the question is now unavoidable.
